sources.source_caption: Video S1 Time-lapse video showing mitochondrial trafficking in axons conducting at 50 Hz in vivo . Mouse saphenous nerve was de-sheathed, the mitochondria labelled with TMRM (red), and stimulated proximally at 50 Hz: conducted CAPs were recorded distally to the imaging site. Many mitochondria are present moving in either direction. Some very long mobile mitochondria are also observed (tracked by blue arrow). A node of Ranvier can be seen in the lowermost axon, but no accumulation of mitochondria near the node is apparent (the foot is to the right). Note: Please use Internet Explorer to download; some browsers seem to distort the video and dramatically reduce their quality. Videos may be best viewed in Windows Media Player.(AVI)Click here for additional data file.
